messages:
alex: FYI we're onboarding the new ORCA org next week. Need a preflight checklist for account/project setup: GPU quota increases in us-west1 and eu-west3, IP/subnet sizing, tags, and cost guardrails. Who can own the quota requests?
maria: I can take point on GCP. Quick checklist I'm thinking: billing account linked, org policy for enforced labels, IAM roles (billing.admin, compute.admin, serviceAccountUser), project naming, VPC with /20 for nodes + secondary ranges for pods/services, reserve 50 static external IPs, request GPUs (V100/P4) quota increase per region, and raise internal loadbalancer forwarding rule quota if needed.
linh: For AWS side: create master account + SCPs, org-unit for ORCA, IAM roles (cross-account deploy role), bootstrap AWS Landing Zone tags. ENI / IP exhaustion is common — request increase of ENI per instance and VPC IPv4 CIDR to allow enough /24s for subnets. Also consider Capacity Reservations for p4d if we need predictable perf.
jay: Cost note: before we bump to dedicated/reserved, get baseline of steady-state vs spike. Suggest requesting soft limit increases first so we don't get billed for unused capacity. Also add a quota alert in billing export if spend > $X/day.
sam: Tagging policy: require these labels on every project: team, cost_center, env, owner. We should create an org policy to enforce labels on resource creation. Snippet I used before:```json
{
  "constraint": "constraints/gcp.requireOrgPolicy",
  "enforce": true,
  "requiredLabels": ["team","cost_center","env","owner"]
}
```
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-3892 for GCP quota request (V100/US-WEST1) and INF-3893 for EU-WEST3. Assigned to maria.
cloud-support: Update: GCP ticket INF-3892 created, estimated response 48-72 hrs. Please attach workload profile (expected qps, avg seq len, peak tokens/min) to speed up. AWS SR 987654 opened for ENI / EC2-GPU quota, case owner: Kiran.
maria: Uploading workload profile now. Also note GKE clusters need large secondary ranges: pods /14 and services /20 recommended for big fleets.
alex: What about static VIPs for model endpoints? We need stable IPs for client allowlists.
linh: Reserve regional static IPs in each region and attach to LB. For AWS use Elastic IPs + NLB with cross-zone enabled. Make sure NAT gateway SNAT ports are sufficient — might need to request higher ephemeral port limit if we have many outbound connections.
jay: One gotcha: some regions have no immediate p4 availability. Ask support about capacity reservations or alternative regions. Add fallback routing policy in config: prefer us-west1, fallback to us-west2 then eu-west3.
sam: Also add an automation step: terraform template that creates project, org policies, VPC with subnets, default nodepools with taints for GPU nodes, and a tagging enforcement plan. Put a policy as code PR check.
maria: Commands I ran last time: `gcloud compute addresses create orca-static-1 --region=us-west1 --addresses=...` and `gcloud compute project-info add-metadata --metadata enable-oslogin=TRUE`. For quota: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas. Attach required spreadsheets to the tickets.
alex: Any blockers on IP quotas? We hit IP exhaustion in the staging account last month.
cloud-support: Staging exhaustion looked like many ephemeral clusters leaking IPs. Recommend secondary-range cleanup job and set `--cluster-secondary-range-pod` with /19 minimum. We can add automated reclamation of orphaned NodePort LoadBalancers.
linh: Reminder for AWS: ENI limits correlate to instance types. For large GPU pools consider using smaller instance counts in a placement group or use EFA where supported. For massive scale, plan for custom VPC with large CIDR (/16) and multiple AZ subnets.
jay: Let's set cost guardrails: set budget alerts at 50%, 80%, 100% of forecast, and an auto-scaling cap on GPU nodepools that keeps baseline under reserved capacity unless explicitly approved.
maria: I've attached the workbook with token/sec estimates and a recommended quota ask: 120 GPUs in us-west1 (mix p4/p3), 60 in eu-west3. Also requested 200 static IPs regionally in each target region.
alex: Perfect. Maria, can you post ticket links + attach terraform templates to the ORCA onboarding doc? Sam, can you draft the org policy PR for required labels?
sam: On it. Will have PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
maria: Ticket links: GCP INF-3892 (V100 US-WEST1) https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/INF-3892, INF-3893 (EU-WEST3) https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/INF-3893. AWS SR 987654 console link shared in the ticket.
ops-bot: Reminder: onboarding runbook meeting scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT. Calendar invite sent.
alex: Thanks everyone — this checklist looks good. We'll run through in the runbook call and close gaps. :rocket:
